player_prompt.intro:
I ye jɛkulu {player_id} kɛ ɲɔgɔn cɛ Reverse Tic Tac Toe. A kɛlɛ ye '{symbol}'.
Tɛmɛnya ye ko: an wɛrɛ sisan i ka kɛlɛ kɔnɔ (hɔrɔzɔntali, vɛrtikali, walla diɲɔnali).
Ika jɛkulu sisan i ka kɛlɛ kɔnɔ, i kɔnɔna.
Ka kɛlɛndɛ a yen kɛlɛ '[4]' de ye kɛlɛ kɛlɛ kɔnɔ 4.
A jɛkulu {player_id} ye, i ye '{symbol}' ani a kɛlɛdɔn ye '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: A tɛ se ka kɛ. I bɛ '[cell]' ta.

game_action.placed: Jɛkulu {player_id} yan jɛkulu kɛlɛ ({symbol}) kɔnɔ kɛlɛ {cell}.

outcome.loss: Player {player_id} loses by completing a line!
outcome.draw: It's a draw! No one lost.
